questions.question: You’re a Senior Engineer on the Modem Protocol team, working on LTE/NR RRC. Is that still your role, and what are you working toward right now?
questions.answer: I'm a senior engineer on the Modem Protocol team, LTE/NR RRC, in Bangalore. Right now I'm getting the RRC re-establishment fix into the November release and leading our 3GPP RAN2 contributions.

questions.question: Who matters most in your work, and how should NexusAI treat their mail? You can name people or organizations and say what makes their mail important.
questions.answer: Meera Iyer is my manager. Karthik Nair leads PLM releases for our team. Wei Zhang is our counterpart in the Seoul HQ modem group. Rahul Sharma, Divya Menon and Sanjay Rao are on my team. Anything from Meera, release blockers, customer escalations, 3GPP contribution deadlines, and anything HR or IT says I personally must do by a date. PLM builds, Swarm code reviews, 3GPP work, HR and IT.

questions.question: What mail is low priority or something you never want to be bothered by, and how would you like genuinely urgent items surfaced?
questions.answer: Anything from Meera, release blockers, customer escalations, 3GPP contribution deadlines, and anything HR or IT says I personally must do by a date. Celebrations, cafeteria and transport notices, town hall recaps, newsletters and vendor marketing. I'm not a people manager, so manager-only actions don't apply to me. Only notify me for things due today or by tomorrow morning. Everything else can wait for my Today page.
